data.name: Midnight Haunting
data.detailed_description:
[About This Game]

Survive the Twisted Midnight Streets

Past midnight, the once-familiar city has morphed into an unsettling, chilling nightmare. In Midnight Haunting, you have only one goal: make it home alive. However, an array of deadly traps hidden within the thick darkness and fog block your path, waiting to claim your life.

Precise Classic Platforming

Tread carefully, hang from ledges, and leap over hazards. Every movement carries physical weight, and a single hasty decision or misstep will lead to a brutal end.

[Key Features]

  • Unforgiving Death Traps: Crumbling floors, hidden hazards striking from the shadows, and sudden ghostly ambushes. Analyze and overcome cunningly placed traps scattered throughout the dark streets.

  • Haunting Atmosphere: Flickering streetlights, unsettling shadows, and unidentified footsteps blend together to create an isolating, tense midnight horror experience where you can never drop your guard.

  • Precise, Weighty Controls: A modern reimagining of the classic cinematic platformer experience. Realistic animations and deliberate mechanics convey the sheer desperation of survival.

  • Death and Mastery: Dying is simply the process of learning the rules of these streets. Memorize the terrain, master the trap patterns, and experience a thrilling sense of accomplishment when you finally open your front door.

data.short_description: The road home is never safe. Midnight Haunting is a 2D survival action game that demands the deliberate controls of a classic cinematic platformer. Survive a haunting, twisted midnight street riddled with deadly traps to reach the safety of your front door. Your next step could always be your last.
